scenario.zh: 为海洋监测星座配置在轨AI,筛选出高价值图像后再下传,降低带宽成本
scenario.en: Configure on-orbit AI for ocean monitoring constellation to filter high-value images before downlink

instruction.zh: 决定AI模型在星座中的部署策略
instruction.en: Decide how AI models are deployed across the constellation

output.zh: 每颗卫星运行完整模型副本,延迟低但内存占用较高
output.en: Each satellite runs full model copy, lower latency but higher memory footprint

output.zh: 模型层跨多星分布,单星内存需求减少,适合大型模型
output.en: Model layers distributed across satellites, reduces per-unit memory, suits larger models

instruction.zh: 设定AI在轨判断的优先级条件
instruction.en: Set priority conditions for on-orbit AI filtering

output.zh: AI标记含船只、溢油或非法捕捞特征的图像,其余场景丢弃
output.en: AI flags images with vessels, spills, or illegal fishing signatures, discards empty scenes

output.zh: AI评估图像清晰度,仅下传晴空或低云覆盖的高质量数据
output.en: AI evaluates image clarity, downlinks only clear-sky or low-cloud high-quality data

instruction.zh: 查看在轨筛选与全量下传的资源差异
instruction.en: Review resource differences between on-orbit filtering and bulk downlink

output.zh: 所有原始图像下传,地面筛选,每日带宽和存储成本高
output.en: All raw images downlinked, ground filtering, high daily bandwidth and storage cost

output.zh: 仅下传AI标记的目标图像,带宽需求大幅降低,地面处理负担减轻
output.en: Only downlinks AI-flagged target images, bandwidth demand sharply reduced, ground load lighter

instruction.zh: 审核最终配置并准备上传至星座
instruction.en: Review final configuration and prepare upload to constellation

output.zh: 配置已打包,单星验证后可扩展至全星座
output.en: Configuration packaged, single-satellite validation before fleet-wide rollout

output.zh: 所有卫星同步接收AI模型和筛选规则,立即生效
output.en: All satellites receive AI model and filter rules synchronously, takes effect immediately

takeaway.zh: 在轨AI让卫星自主筛选数据,显著降低下传成本,提高任务响应速度
takeaway.en: On-orbit AI enables satellites to autonomously filter data, sharply cutting downlink costs and boosting mission responsiveness
